questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: The right lane is ending ahead. Be prepared to move to another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Railroad crossing.
questions.explanation: A railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: A traffic signal is coming up ahead. Be ready to stop or follow the light's instructions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
Operators may turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you can either turn right or go straight. You cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: The road ahead will curve right first, then curve left. Slow down and be ready for both curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bicycle crossing.
questions.explanation: Bicycles cross or travel here regularly. Drive slowly and watch for cyclists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Work is happening on the road ahead. Slow down and be careful in the construction zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Curve ahead.
questions.explanation: A curve is coming up in the road. Slow down and be ready to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: A railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down and let any trains pass. Trains cannot stop for cars.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: The road becomes slippery when it rains or gets wet. Drive slowly and carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted limit. Poor conditions require you to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: A four-way intersection is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Green, yellow, and red.
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are ordered from bottom to top: green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Side road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Keep right.
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is beginning. The road splits into two separate one-way roads with a divider between them. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action shown is not allowed. This sign shows a right turn is prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs always mean stop. You must come to a complete stop and check that the road is clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Winding road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns that a winding road is ahead and you should reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves right ahead. Slow down to the safe speed shown (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Two-way traffic.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that traffic may be coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for bicycles.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first before entering the intersection or roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to conditions on or near the road ahead. They are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road will meet a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roadways separated by a median or guard rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Divided highway ends.
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign requires you to come to a complete stop and let vehicles and pedestrians in or entering the intersection go first. Proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Flagger ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a flagger is ahead directing traffic through a construction area.
